userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: Entrance sign: welcome for a vehicle with no standing right, which pays for its stay (Part 26 §26.9).
Entrance sign: welcome for a vehicle a permit or monthly right covers.
Entrance sign: service refused, the vend withheld (a plate list with refuseService, Part 24 §24.4). The record is the proof of display.
Exit sign: the stay is paid; thank you.
Exit sign: no payment found for the stay. Also shown for an overstay or a late start until kinds for those are added.
Exit sign: goodbye for a vehicle a permit or monthly right covers.
Exit sign: a permit or monthly holder with a balance due on the account.
Either sign: the resting message shown when no vehicle is being served.
Either sign: the message shown when the system that drives the sign cannot decide which message applies (no read, no rights data).
